title: Unit 3 : Session 11 : SLO 1 — IEEE 754 Single Precision Format
sections: A. Sign Bit → 2. Indicates positive or negative number
B. Exponent Bias → 3. 127 in single precision
C. Fraction (Mantissa) → 1. 23 bits used for precision representation
D. Total bits in IEEE 754 (Single) → 5. 32 bits total
E. Exponent Field → 4. Converts decimal exponent to binary
IEEE 754 single precision = 32 bits: 1 sign bit (bit 31), 8 exponent bits with bias 127 (bits 30-23), 23 mantissa/fraction bits (bits 22-0).
